**My top pick for an RV under $900 is the <Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L" disambig="2048Wh portable power station"/>.** It offers a strong combination of RV compatibility, battery capacity, AC output, and solar charging.

## Best options compared

| Model | Reported price | Key advantage |
|---|---:|---|
| **BLUETTI AC200L** | $899 | Best overall RV features and solar input |
| <Entity category="product" value="Renogy PowerStation 2000"/> | $849 | Lower-cost RV-ready alternative |
| <Entity category="product" value="Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2"/> | $899.99 | Lightest TT-30 option at 41.7 lb |
| <Entity category="product" value="Jackery Explorer 2000 v2"/> | $899 | Lightweight at 39.5 lb, but no built-in TT-30 |

Prices are from the supplied search results, mostly checked in late October 2026, and may have changed. <Cite refs={["turn493457view0"]}/>

## Why I'd choose the BLUETTI

- **RV-ready connection:** Its built-in TT-30 outlet connects to a standard 30A RV shore-power cord.
- **Good appliance support:** Its 2,400W inverter can handle typical combinations of lights, a fridge, a water pump, and smaller kitchen appliances, within its output limit.
- **Better solar potential:** Up to 1,200W of solar input makes it appealing for extended off-grid camping.
- **Expandable capacity:** Useful if your power requirements increase later.

## Important limitation

A TT-30 outlet does not mean you get a full 30 amps. At 120V, the AC200L's 2,400W output is approximately **20 amps**. It generally won't support a rooftop RV air conditioner alongside other substantial loads.

Also, its 2,048Wh battery provides roughly 1.7–1.9kWh of usable AC energy under favorable conditions, so high-power appliances will drain it quickly.

**Bottom line:** Choose the BLUETTI AC200L for RV hookups and solar charging. Choose the Renogy PowerStation 2000 if saving $50 matters more. If portability is your priority, consider the Anker C2000 Gen 2.

One purchasing caution: the supplied results report that the AC200L is nearing the end of its product life, so confirm stock, warranty coverage, and final checkout price before buying.
